_comment: Business thresholds used by the analysis workflow and report agents.

profit_rate.desc: profit_rate < 10% means immediate intervention; do not scale volume until confirmed.
profit_rate.desc_w: profit_rate < 13% means pricing should be evaluated within the current quarter.
profit_rate.desc_h: profit_rate >= 15% means the structure is healthy.

yoy_growth.desc_w: yoy_growth < 5% means weak growth and requires focused analysis.

profit_rate_drop.desc: profit_rate drop > 2pp means structural change and requires attribution.
profit_rate_drop.desc_e: single-month profit_rate drop > 5pp means promotion or event impact should be checked first.

desc: Stop drilling into a branch when its discovered impact is below 3%.
